changes: Added General-page Skyrim preset code generator for pasted Dynamite/Almighty codes.
Added editable preset values for All Skills Level, Carry Weight, Health/Magicka/Stamina, Add EXP, and Perk Points.
Added copy-ready generated Save Wizard custom-code output.
Improved Quick Code decoder so whole pasted tables with credits/notes are accepted and non-code text is ignored.
Improved Type 8/B search decoding so following search-data words are consumed instead of misread as write codes.
safety: Preset codes remain copy/generator only because they are search/pointer codes, not verified direct ESS offsets. Existing General direct edits still use mapped save offsets and backups.
